SELECT
  dd.month,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.sales_amount, fs.units_sold * fs.unit_price)) AS total_sales_amount
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Date dd ON fs.date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = :year
GROUP BY dd.month
ORDER BY dd.month;

SELECT
  dp.brand,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.sales_amount, fs.units_sold * fs.unit_price))
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.sale_id), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd    ON fs.date_key    = dd.date_key
WHERE dp.brand IN (:brand_1, :brand_2)
  AND dd.year = :year
  AND dd.quarter = :quarter
GROUP BY dp.brand
ORDER BY average_order_value DESC;

SELECT
  ds.store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.product_key) AS unique_products_sold
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE ds.city = :city
  AND dd.year = :year
GROUP BY ds.store_name
ORDER BY unique_products_sold DESC;

SELECT
  dp.category,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.sales_amount, fs.units_sold * fs.unit_price))
    / NULLIF(SUM(fs.units_sold), 0) AS revenue_per_unit
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE dp.department = :department
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY revenue_per_unit DESC;

SELECT
  ds.district,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.sales_amount, fs.units_sold * fs.unit_price))
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.store_key), 0) AS sales_per_store
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = :year
  AND dd.quarter = :quarter
GROUP BY ds.district
ORDER BY sales_per_store DESC;

SELECT
  dd.date,
  SUM(COALESCE(fs.sales_amount, fs.units_sold * fs.unit_price)) AS total_sales_amount
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE ds.store_name = :store_name
  AND dd.date BETWEEN DATE :start_date AND DATE :end_date
GROUP BY dd.date
ORDER BY dd.date;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.store_key) AS active_stores
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE ds.state = :state
  AND dd.year = :year;

SELECT
  ds.store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dd.date) AS active_days
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE ds.state = :state
  AND dd.year = :year
GROUP BY ds.store_name
ORDER BY active_days DESC;

SELECT
  ds.district,
  dd.month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.sale_id) AS total_transactions
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Store ds ON fs.store_key = ds.store_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd  ON fs.date_key  = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = :year
GROUP BY ds.district, dd.month
ORDER BY ds.district, dd.month;

SELECT
  dp.type AS type,
  AVG(fs.unit_price) AS average_unit_price
FROM Fact_Sales fs
JOIN Dim_Product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
JOIN Dim_Date dd    ON fs.date_key    = dd.date_key
WHERE dp.category = :category
  AND dd.year = :year
GROUP BY dp.type
ORDER BY average_unit_price DESC;
